Brockman joins an all-star list of tech executives slated to attend, including OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Amazon

The feud continued this month when Amodei stressed the importance of "pacing the rate of capabilities advancement so that risk prevention has time to keep up" regarding AI development.

"The Trump Administration has stopped AI 'people' from doing bad, or potentially bad, 'things,' like Dario (Anthropic!), who is now pretending to be a 'perfect little angel' - and we will continue to do so!," Trump replied on Truth Social.

The dinner occurs with the backdrop of several tech executives calling for a deliberate pacing in the development of frontier AI models, while Trump wants to ensure the U.S. wins the AI race with China. Officials and executives are expected to discuss AI, trade, and other issues.

The addition of Brockman is important, not only for his role at OpenAI but also due to his contributions to MAGA Inc. Brockman and his wife Anna donated a combined $25M to the super PAC in 2025. The PAC raises money and runs advertisements and events to support Trump and his political allies. Brockman has said that his contributions are intended to support politicians and policies favorable to the AI industry.
